propositions: A superseded ticket with a live supersedes/duplicates link cannot be closed via rebar transition --class=superseded because the plan-review close gate demands a certified attestation that the ticket cannot earn.
rebar review-plan on a superseded ticket correctly blocks with findings that the work already exists elsewhere, making the attestation requirement unsatisfiable by construction.

close_plan_review_gate_check lacks the close_class parameter and cannot distinguish administrative dispositions backed by live links, treating all closes identically and refusing them without attestation.

The plan-review close gate must be exempted for link-backed administrative dispositions (superseded, duplicate) when live replacement links exist, matching the behavior of the completion-verification gate.
Closing a superseded ticket with --force degrades the audit trail by recording no signed attestation, and prevents ancestor tickets from earning completion signatures retroactively.
